verses.geez: አሌፍ። እፎ፡ ነበረት፡ ባሕቲታ፡ ሀገር፡ እንተ፡ ምልእት፡ ሕዝበ፡ ወኮነት፡ መበለተ፡ እንተ፡ ትኴንን፡ አሕዛበ፡ ወእንተ፡ ትኴንን፡ በሓውርተ፡ ገብአት፡ ውስተ፡ ጸዋር።
verses.translation: Aleph. How does the city that was filled with people sit solitary! she is become as a widow: she that was magnified among the nations, and princess among the provinces, has become tributary.

translations.lxx: Aleph. How does the city that was filled with people sit solitary! she is become as a widow: she that was magnified among the nations, and princess among the provinces, has become tributary.
translations.kjv: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!
translations.ron: O, cum a rămas pustie cetatea cea cu mult popor! Cum a ajuns ca o văduvă cea mai de frunte dintre neamuri; doamna cetăţilor a ajuns birnică.
translations.grk: ΑΛΕΦ. Πῶς ἐκάθισε μόνη ἡ πόλις ἡ πεπληθυμμένη λαῶν; ἐγενήθη ὡς χήρα, πεπληθυμμένη ἐν ἔθνεσιν, ἄρχουσα ἐν χώραις ἐγενήθη εἰς φόρον.

verses.geez: ቤት። ብካየ፡ በከየት፡ በሌሊት፡ ወአንብዐ፡ ውስተ፡ መልታሕታ፡ ውሕዘ፡ ወኀጥአት፡ ዘይናዝዛ፡ እምኵሎሙ፡ ዘያፈቅርዋ፡ ወተፃረርዋ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ፍቁራኒሃ፡ ወኮኑ፡ ላቲ፡ ጸላእተ።
verses.translation: Beth. She weeps sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; and there is none of all her lovers to comfort her: all that were her friends have dealt deceitfully with her, they are become her enemies.

translations.lxx: Beth. She weeps sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; and there is none of all her lovers to comfort her: all that were her friends have dealt deceitfully with her, they are become her enemies.
translations.kjv: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
translations.ron: Noaptea plânge întruna cu lacrimi pe obraz şi dintre toţi câţi o iubeau, nici unul n-o mai mângâie; toţi prietenii au devenit duşmani.
translations.grk: ΒΗΘ. Κλαίουσα ἔκλαυσεν ἐν νυκτὶ, καὶ τὰ δάκρυα αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τῶν σιαγόνων αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρχει ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων αὐτήν· πάντες οἱ φιλοῦντες αὐτὴν ἠθέτησαν ἐν αὐτῇ, ἐγένοντο αὐτῇ εἰς ἐχθρούς.

verses.geez: ጋሜል። ፈለሰት፡ ይሁዳ፡ በኀሣራ፡ ወበብዝኀ፡ ቅኔሃ፡ ወነበረት፡ ውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወአልባ፡ ዕረፍት፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ዴገንዋ፡ አኀዝዋ፡ በማእከለ፡ እለ፡ አስርሕዋ።
verses.translation: Gimel. Judea is gone into captivity by reason of her affliction, and by reason of the abundance of her servitude: she dwells among the nations, she has not found rest: all her pursuers have overtaken her between her oppressors.

translations.lxx: Gimel. Judea is gone into captivity by reason of her affliction, and by reason of the abundance of her servitude: she dwells among the nations, she has not found rest: all her pursuers have overtaken her between her oppressors.
translations.kjv: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
translations.ron: Iuda s-a dus în robie, la suferinţă şi la muncă grea; sălăşluieşte printre neamuri şi nu-şi află odihnă. Toţi asupritorii lui l-au prins la strâmtorare.
translations.grk: ΓΙΜΕΛ. Μετῳκίσθη Ἰουδαία ἀπὸ ταπεινώσεως αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀπὸ πλήθους δουλείας αὐτῆς· ἐκάθισεν ἐν ἔθνεσιν, οὐχ εὗρεν ἀνάπαυσιν· πάντες οἱ καταδιώκοντες αὐτὴν, κατέλαβον αὐτὴν ἀναμέσον τῶν θλιβόντων.

verses.geez: ዳሌጥ። ፍናዊሃ፡ ለጽዮን፡ ይላሕውዋ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ ለበዓል፡ ወማሰነ፡ ኵሉ፡ አናቅጺሃ፡ ካህናቲሃኒ፡ ይበክዩ፡ ወደናሊሃ፡ ተፄወዋ፡ ወለሊሃ፡ መራረ፡ ኮነት።
verses.translation: Daleth. The ways of Sion mourn, because there are none that come to the feast: all her gates are ruined: her priests groan, her virgins are led captive, and she is in bitterness in herself.

translations.lxx: Daleth. The ways of Sion mourn, because there are none that come to the feast: all her gates are ruined: her priests groan, her virgins are led captive, and she is in bitterness in herself.
translations.kjv: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.
translations.ron: Toate căile Sionului sunt pline de jale şi nimeni nu mai vine la sărbătoare. Toate porţile (cetăţii) sunt pustii, preoţii ei suspină; fecioarele sunt deznădăjduite şi ea este plină de amar.
translations.grk: ΔΑΛΕΘ. Ὁδοὶ Σιὼν πενθοῦσι παρὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἐρχομένους ἐν ἑορτῇ· πᾶσαι αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς ἠφανισμέναι, οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῆς ἀναστενάζουσιν, αἱ παρθένοι αὐτῆς ἀγόμεναι, καὶ αὐτὴ πικραινομένη ἐν ἑαυτῇ.

verses.geez: ሄ። ወኮኑ፡ እለ፡ ሣቀይዋ፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእሳ፡ ወጸላእታሂ፡ ተፈሥሑ፡ እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አኅሠራ፡ በብዝኀ፡ ኀጢአታ፡ ለሕፃናቲሃኒ፡ ፄወውዎሙ፡ በቅድመ፡ እለ፡ ሣቀይዋ።
verses.translation: He. Her oppressors are become the head, and her enemies have prospered; for the Lord has afflicted her because of the multitude of her sins: her young children are gone into captivity before the face of the oppressor.

translations.lxx: He. Her oppressors are become the head, and her enemies have prospered; for the Lord has afflicted her because of the multitude of her sins: her young children are gone into captivity before the face of the oppressor.
translations.kjv: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
translations.ron: Vrăjmaşii ei sunt biruitori, duşmanii ei sunt cu voie bună; căci Domnul a umilit-o din pricina multelor ei păcate, iar feciorii ei au plecat în robie înaintea asupritorului.
translations.grk: Η. Ἐγένοντο οἱ θλίβοντες αὐτὴν εἰς κεφαλὴν, καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῆς εὐθηνοῦσαν, ὅτι Κύριος ἐταπείνωσεν αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἀσεβειῶν αὐτῆς· τὰ νήπια αὐτῆς ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ κατὰ πρόσωπον θλίβοντος.

verses.geez: ዋው። ሰለብዋ፡ ለወለተ፡ ጽዮን፡ ኵሎ፡ ትርሲታ፡ ወኮኑ፡ መላእክቲሃ፡ ከመ፡ አብሐኵ፡ እለ፡ ኀጥኡ፡ ዘይትረዐዩ፡ ወሖሩ፡ ድኩማኒሆሙ፡ ቅድመ፡ እለ፡ ሮድዎሙ።
verses.translation: Vau. And all her beauty has been taken away from the daughter of Sion: her princes were as rams finding no pasture, and are gone away in weakness before the face of the pursuer.

translations.lxx: Vau. And all her beauty has been taken away from the daughter of Sion: her princes were as rams finding no pasture, and are gone away in weakness before the face of the pursuer.
translations.kjv: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
translations.ron: Aşa şi-a irosit fiica Sionului toată strălucirea! Căpeteniile ei sunt asemenea cerbilor care nu află păşune şi fug sleiţi de puteri dinaintea urmăritorului.
translations.grk: ΟΥΑΥ. Καὶ ἐξῄρθη ἐκ θυγατρὸς Σιὼν πᾶσα ἡ εὐπρέπεια αὐτῆς· ἐγένοντο οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῆς ὡς κριοὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκοντες νομὴν, καὶ ἐπορεύοντο ἐν οὐκ ἰσχύϊ κατὰ πρόσωπον διώκοντος.

verses.geez: ዛይ። ተዘከረት፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኀሣራ፡ በኵላ፡ ፍትወታ፡ ዘቀዲሙ፡ ሶበ፡ ተተተ፡ ሕዝባ፡ በእደ፡ ፀሮሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይረድኣ፡ ወርእይዋ፡ ጸላእታ፡ በኀበ፡ ፈለሰት፡ ወሰሐቅዋ።
verses.translation: Zain. Jerusalem remembered the days of her affliction, and her rejection; she thought on all her desirable things which were from the days of old, when her people fell into the hands of the oppressor, and there was none to help her: when her enemies saw it they laughed at her habitation.

translations.lxx: Zain. Jerusalem remembered the days of her affliction, and her rejection; she thought on all her desirable things which were from the days of old, when her people fell into the hands of the oppressor, and there was none to help her: when her enemies saw it they laughed at her habitation.
translations.kjv: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
translations.ron: Ierusalimul îşi aduce aminte de zilele ticăloşiei lui şi ale rătăcirii lui, de toate strălucirile pe care le-a avut în străvechile vremuri. Acum însă, când poporul a căzut în mâna vrăjmaşului şi când nimeni nu-i poate veni în ajutor, duşmanii lui se uită la el şi râd de prăbuşirea lui.
translations.grk: ΖΑΙΝ. Ἐμνήσθη Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἡμερῶν ταπεινώσεως αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀπωσμῶν αὐτῆς· πάντα τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα αὐτῆς ὅσα ἦν ἐξ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων, ἐν τῷ πεσεῖν τὸν λαὸν αὐτῆς εἰς χεῖρας θλίβοντος, καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ βοηθῶν αὐτῇ. ἰδόντες οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῆς, ἐγέλασαν ἐπὶ κατοικεσίᾳ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ሔት። አብሶ፡ አበሰት፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወበእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኮነት፡ ሰቆራረ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይዌድስዋ፡ አኅሠርዋ፡ እስመ፡ ርእዩ፡ ኀሣራ፡ በኀበ፡ ተመንደበት፡ ወወድቀት፡ ድኅሪተ።
verses.translation: Heth. Jerusalem has sinned a great sin; therefore has she come into tribulation, all that used to honour her have afflicted her, for they have seen her shame: yea, she herself groaned, and turned backward.

translations.lxx: Heth. Jerusalem has sinned a great sin; therefore has she come into tribulation, all that used to honour her have afflicted her, for they have seen her shame: yea, she herself groaned, and turned backward.
translations.kjv: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
translations.ron: Ierusalimul a păcătuit de moarte, pentru aceasta a ajuns de spaimă; toţi cei ce-l cinsteau nu-l mai iau în seamă, căci au văzut goliciunea lui, iar el suspină şi îşi întoarce faţa.
translations.grk: ΗΘ. Ἁμαρτίαν ἥμαρτεν Ἱερουσαλὴμ, διατοῦτο εἰς σάλον ἐγένετο· πάντες οἱ δοξάζοντες αὐτὴν, ἐταπείνωσαν αὐτήν· εἶδον γὰρ τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτῆς, καί γε αὐτὴ στενάζουσα καὶ ἀπεστράφη ὀπίσω.

verses.geez: ጤት። ርኵስ፡ ውስተ፡ እገሪሃ፡ ወኢተዘከረት፡ ደኃሪታ፡ ወጾረት፡ ክቡደ፡ ወኢሠኀትዋ። ርኢ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ሕማምየ፡ ከመ፡ ተዘኀሩ፡ ፀርየ።
verses.translation: Teth. Her uncleanness is before her feet; she remembered not her last end; she has lowered her boasting tone, there is none to comfort her. Behold, O Lord, my affliction: for the enemy has magnified himself.

translations.lxx: Teth. Her uncleanness is before her feet; she remembered not her last end; she has lowered her boasting tone, there is none to comfort her. Behold, O Lord, my affliction: for the enemy has magnified himself.
translations.kjv: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.
translations.ron: Necurăţia lui e lipită de poala hainelor lui căci la sfârşitul lui el nu s-a gândit. El s-a prăbuşit în chip uluitor şi n-are pe nimeni să-l mângâie! "Vezi, Doamne, necazul meu, căci vrăjmaşul biruieşte".
translations.grk: ΤΗΘ. Ἀκαθαρσία αὐτῆς πρὸ ποδῶν αὐτῆς· οὐκ ἐμνήσθη ἔσχατα αὐτῆς, καὶ κατεβίβασεν ὑπέρογκα· οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτήν. ἴδε Κύριε τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου, ὅτι ἐμεγαλύνθη ὁ ἐχθρός.

verses.geez: ዮድ። አንሥአ፡ እዴሁ፡ ዘሣቀያ፡ በኵሉ፡ ፍትወታ፡ ርእየት፡ አሕዛበ፡ ዘከላእከ፡ ኢይባኡ፡ ውስተ፡ መቅደስከ።
verses.translation: Jod. The oppressor has stretched out his hand on all her desirable things: for she has seen the Gentiles entering into her sanctuary, concerning whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

translations.lxx: Jod. The oppressor has stretched out his hand on all her desirable things: for she has seen the Gentiles entering into her sanctuary, concerning whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
translations.kjv: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
translations.ron: Duşmanii au întins mâna spre toate vistieriile lui. El a văzut neamuri intrând în templul său, neamuri cărora le-ai dat poruncă: "Să nu intre în obştea ta!"
translations.grk: ΙΩΔ. Χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐξεπέτασε θλίβων ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα αὐτῆς· εἶδε γὰρ ἔθνη εἰσελθόντα εἰς τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτῆς, ἃ ἐνετείλω μὴ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτὰ εἰς ἐκκλησίαν σου.

verses.geez: ካፍ። ኵሉ፡ ሕዝባ፡ ይግዕሩ፡ ወየኀጥኡ፡ እክለ፡ ወወሀቡ፡ ፍትወቶሙ፡ ለመብልዕ፡ ለመይጠ፡ ነፍስ። ርኢ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ወነጽር፡ እስመ፡ ኀሠርኩ።
verses.translation: Chaph. All her people groan, seeking bread: they have given their desirable things for meat, to restore their soul: behold, Lord, and look; for she is become dishonoured.

translations.lxx: Chaph. All her people groan, seeking bread: they have given their desirable things for meat, to restore their soul: behold, Lord, and look; for she is become dishonoured.
translations.kjv: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
translations.ron: Tot poporul Tău suspină căutând pâine, şi îşi dau odoarele lor pentru mâncare, ca să-şi ţină viaţa. Vezi, Doamne, şi ia aminte cum am ajuns de ocară!
translations.grk: ΧΑΦ. Πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτῆς καταστενάζοντες, ζητοῦντες ἄρτον· ἔδωκαν τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα αὐτῆς ἐν βρώσει, τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι ψυχήν· ἴδε Κύριε καὶ ἐπίβλεψον, ὅτι ἐγενήθη ἠτιμωμένη.

verses.geez: ላሜድ። አልቦ፡ ኀቤክሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀላፍያነ፡ ፍኖት፡ ተመየጡ፡ ወርእዩ፡ እመ፡ ቦ፡ ቊስል፡ ከመ፡ ቊስልየ፡ ዘአሕመመኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በዕለተ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ መዐቱ።
verses.translation: Lamed. All ye that pass by the way, turn, and see if there is sorrow like to my sorrow, which has happened to me. The Lord who spoke by me has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

translations.lxx: Lamed. All ye that pass by the way, turn, and see if there is sorrow like to my sorrow, which has happened to me. The Lord who spoke by me has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
translations.kjv: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
translations.ron: O, voi trecătorilor, priviţi şi vedeţi dacă este vreo durere ca aceea care mă copleşeşte şi cu care Domnul m-a umplut de necaz în ziua întăririi mâniei Lui.
translations.grk: ΛΑΜΕΔ. Οἱ πρὸς ὑμᾶς πάντες παραπορευόμενοι ὁδὸν, ἐπιστρέψατε καὶ ἴδετε εἰ ἔστιν ἄλγος κατὰ τὸ ἄλγος μου, ὃ ἐγενήθη· φθεγξάμενος ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐταπείνωσέ με Κύριος ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ሜም። እምአርያም፡ ፈነወ፡ እሳተ፡ ወአሕለለ፡ አዕፅምትየ፡ ወሰፍሐ፡ መሥገርቶ፡ ለእገርየ፡ ወአግብአኒ፡ ድኅሬየ፡ ወአማሰነኒ፡ ወአሕመመኒ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዕለተ።
verses.translation: Mem. He has sent fire from his lofty habitation, he has brought it into my bones: he has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: he has made me desolate and mourning all the day.

translations.lxx: Mem. He has sent fire from his lofty habitation, he has brought it into my bones: he has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: he has made me desolate and mourning all the day.
translations.kjv: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
translations.ron: Foc a trimis de sus peste oasele mele şi m-a smerit, picioarelor mele le-a întins cursă, şi m-a făcut să dau înapoi; pustiitu-m-a cu totul, iar eu toată ziua bolesc.
translations.grk: ΜΗΜ. Ἐξ ὕψους αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλε πῦρ, ἐν τοῖς ὀστέοις μου κατήγαγεν αὐτό· διεπέτασε δίκτυον τοῖς ποσί μου, ἀπέστρεψέ με εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω· ἔδωκέ με ἠφανισμένην, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ὠδυνωμένην.

verses.geez: ኖን። ተግሀ፡ በእንተ፡ ኀጢአትየ፡ ዘተፀፍረ፡ በእደውየ፡ ዐርገ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሳድየ፡ ወደክመ፡ ኀይልየ፡ እስመ፡ መጠወኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ሕማም፡ በዘኢይክል፡ ቀዊመ።
verses.translation: Nun. He has watched over my sins, they are twined about my hands, they have come up on my neck: my strength has failed; for the Lord has laid pains on my hands, I shall not be able to stand.

translations.lxx: Nun. He has watched over my sins, they are twined about my hands, they have come up on my neck: my strength has failed; for the Lord has laid pains on my hands, I shall not be able to stand.
translations.kjv: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the LORD hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
translations.ron: Jugul păcatelor mele mi-a fost legat de gât de către mâna Lui; strânse ca într-un mănunchi, ele atârnă de grumazul meu; El a făcut să se destrame puterea mea şi m-a dat în mâna celor cărora nu puteam să mă împotrivesc.
translations.grk: ΝΟΥΝ. Ἐγρηγορήθη ἐπὶ τὰ ἀσεβήματά μου, ἐν χερσί μου συνεπλάκησαν· ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλόν μου· ἠσθένησεν ἡ ἰσχύς μου· ὅτι ἔδωκε Κύριος ἐν χερσί μου ὀδύνας, οὐ δυνήσομαι στῆναι.

verses.geez: ሳምኬት። አእተቶሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ኀያላንየ፡ እማእከሌየ፡ ጸውዐ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ መዋዕለ፡ በዘይትቀጠቀጡ፡ ኅሩያንየ። ወነፅኃ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለድንግል፡ ወለተ፡ ይሁዳ፡ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ እበኪ፡ አነ።
verses.translation: Samech. The Lord has cut off all my strong men from the midst of me: he has summoned against me a time for crushing my choice men: the Lord has trodden a wine-press for the virgin daughter of Juda: for these things I weep.

translations.lxx: Samech. The Lord has cut off all my strong men from the midst of me: he has summoned against me a time for crushing my choice men: the Lord has trodden a wine-press for the virgin daughter of Juda: for these things I weep.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the LORD hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.
translations.ron: Domnul a spulberat pe toţi voinicii din mijlocul meu, El a chemat oaste împotriva mea, ca să sfărâme pe voinicii mei. Stăpânul a toate a strivit ca în teasc pe fecioara, fiica lui Iuda.
translations.grk: ΣΑΜΕΧ. Ἐξῇρε πάντας τοὺς ἰσχυρούς μου ὁ Κύριος ἐκ μέσου μου, ἐκάλεσεν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ καιρὸν τοῦ συντρίψαι ἐκλεκτούς μου· ληνὸν ἐπάτησε Κύριος παρθένῳ θυγατρὶ Ἰούδα· ἐπὶ τούτοις ἐγὼ κλαίω.

verses.geez: ዔ። ዐይንየ፡ አውሐዘት፡ ማየ፡ እስመ፡ ርኅቀ፡ እምኔየ፡ ዘይናዝዘኒ፡ ወዘያገብኣ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ ወማሰኑ፡ ደቂቅየ፡ እስመ፡ ሞአ፡ ፀር።
verses.translation: Ain. Mine eye has poured out water, because he that should comfort me, that should restore my soul, has been removed far from me: my sons have been destroyed, because the enemy has prevailed.

translations.lxx: Ain. Mine eye has poured out water, because he that should comfort me, that should restore my soul, has been removed far from me: my sons have been destroyed, because the enemy has prevailed.
translations.kjv: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta eu plâng mereu, din ochii mei izvorăsc lacrimi, căci departe de mine este Mângâietorul, Cel ce-mi îmbărbăta inima. Feciorii mei cu toţii au fost daţi pieirii, căci duşmanul a avut biruinţă.
translations.grk: ΑΙΝ. Ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου κατήγαγεν ὕδωρ, ὅτι ἐμακρύνθη ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ ὁ παρακαλῶν με, ὁ ἐπιστρέφων ψυχήν μου· ἐγένοντο οἱ υἱοί μου ἠφανισμένοι, ὅτι ἐκραταιώθη ὁ ἐχθρός.

verses.geez: ፌ። አንሥአት፡ እደዊሃ፡ ጽዮን፡ ወኀጥአት፡ ዘይላሕያ። ወአዘዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ ይዕግትዎ፡ እለ፡ ይረውድዎ፡ ወኮነት፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ትክተ፡ በማእከሎሙ።
verses.translation: Phe. Sion has spread out her hand, and there is none to comfort her: the Lord has commanded concerning Jacob, his oppressors are round about him: Jerusalem has become among them as a removed woman.

translations.lxx: Phe. Sion has spread out her hand, and there is none to comfort her: the Lord has commanded concerning Jacob, his oppressors are round about him: Jerusalem has become among them as a removed woman.
translations.kjv: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
translations.ron: Sionul întinde mâinile sale şi nimeni nu-l mângâie! Domnul a dat poruncă tuturor vrăjmaşilor lui Iacov ca să-l împresoare. Ajuns-a Ierusalimul înaintea ochilor lor ca un lucru spurcat.
translations.grk: ΦΗ. Διεπέτασε Σιὼν χεῖρα αὐτῆς, οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτήν· ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Ἰακὼβ, κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ οἱ θλίβοντες αὐτόν· ἐγενήθη Ἱερουσαλὴμ εἰς ἀποκαθημένην ἀναμέσον αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ጻዴ። ጻድቅ፡ ውእቱ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ፡ ወሐክዎ፡ ለአፉሁ። ስምዑ፡ ኵልክሙ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወርእዩ፡ ቊስልየ፡ እስመ፡ ፄወውዎሙ፡ ለደናግልየ፡ ወለወራዙትየ።
verses.translation: Tsade. The Lord is righteous; for I have provoked his mouth: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my grief: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

translations.lxx: Tsade. The Lord is righteous; for I have provoked his mouth: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my grief: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
translations.kjv: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
translations.ron: Drept este Domnul, căci împotriva poruncilor Lui m-am răzvrătit. Luaţi aminte, voi, toate popoarele, şi vedeţi necazul meu: fecioarele mele şi flăcăii mei au fost duşi în robie.
translations.grk: ΤΣΑΔΗ. Δίκαιός ἐστι Κύριος, ὅτι στόμα αὐτοῦ παρεπίκρανα· ἀκούσατε δὴ πάντες οἱ λαοὶ, καὶ ἴδετε τὸ ἄλγος μου· παρθένοι μου καὶ νεανίσκοι μου ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ.

verses.geez: ቆፍ። ጸዋዕክዎሙ፡ ለመሐዛንየ፡ ወተጸመሙኒ። ካህናትየኒ፡ ወረበናትየ፡ ኀልቁ፡ በሀገር፡ ሶበ፡ ኀሠሡ፡ ዘይበልዑ፡ በዘይመይጡ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ወኀጥኡ።
verses.translation: Koph. I called my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and my elders failed in the city; for they sought meat that they might restore their souls, and found it not.

translations.lxx: Koph. I called my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and my elders failed in the city; for they sought meat that they might restore their souls, and found it not.
translations.kjv: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
translations.ron: Strigat-am către iubiţii mei, dar ei m-au înşelat; preoţii mei şi bătrânii mei au pierit în cetate, când căutau hrană ca să-şi ţină viaţa.
translations.grk: ΚΩΦ. Ἐκάλεσα τοὺς ἐραστάς μου, αὐτοὶ δὲ παρελογίσαντό με· οἱ ἱερεῖς μου καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροί μου ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐξέλιπον, ὅτι ἐζήτησαν βρῶσιν αὐτοῖς ἵνα ἐπιστρέψωσι ψυχὰς αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐχ εὗρον.

verses.geez: ሬስ። ርኢ፡ እግዚኦ፡ እስመ፡ ሐመምኩ፡ ወተከውሰት፡ ከርሥየ፡ ወልብየ፡ ተመይጠ፡ በላዕሌየ፡ እስመ፡ መሪረ፡ መረርኩ፡ በአፍኣኒ፡ አምከነተኒ፡ መጥባሕት፡ ወብድብድ፡ በውስተ፡ ቤት።
verses.translation: Rhechs. Behold, O Lord; for I am afflicted: my belly is troubled, and my heart is turned within me; for I have been grievously rebellious: abroad the sword has bereaved me, even as death at home.

translations.lxx: Rhechs. Behold, O Lord; for I am afflicted: my belly is troubled, and my heart is turned within me; for I have been grievously rebellious: abroad the sword has bereaved me, even as death at home.
translations.kjv: Behold, O LORD; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
translations.ron: Vezi, Doamne, cât sunt de strâmtorat, lăuntrul meu arde! Inima mea se zbuciumă în trupul meu, pentru că m-am răzvrătit foarte. Afară sabia seceră pe feciorii mei, iar înăuntru, moartea.
translations.grk: ΡΗΧΣ. Ἴδε, Κύριε, ὅτι θλίβομαι, ἡ κοιλία μου ἐταράχθη, καὶ ἡ καρδία μου ἐστράφη ἐν ἐμοὶ, ὅτι παραπικραίνουσα παρεπικράνθην, ἔξωθεν ἠτέκνωσέ με μάχαιρα, ὥσπερ θάνατος ἐν οἴκῳ.

verses.geez: ሳን። ስምዑኒ፡ ዘከመ፡ እግዕር፡ አነ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያንህየኒ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ፀርየ፡ ሰምዑ፡ ሕማምየ፡ ወተፈሥሑ፡ እስመ፡ አንተ፡ ገበርከ፡ በዘአምጻእከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ጸዋዕከ፡ ወኮኑ፡ ከማየ።
verses.translation: Chsen. Hear, I pray you, for I groan: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of mine afflictions, and rejoice because thou hast done it: thou hast brought on the day, thou hast called the time: they are become like to me.

translations.lxx: Chsen. Hear, I pray you, for I groan: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of mine afflictions, and rejoice because thou hast done it: thou hast brought on the day, thou hast called the time: they are become like to me.
translations.kjv: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
translations.ron: Toţi aud suspinul meu, dar nimeni nu mă mângâie! Toii duşmanii, aflând de nenorocirea mea, se bucură că ai făcut aşa. Să vină peste ei ziua pe care ai făgăduit-o şi să ajungă şi ei ca mine!
translations.grk: ΧΣΕΝ. Ακούσατε δὴ, ὅτι στενάζω ἐγὼ, οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ παρακαλῶν με· πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί μου ἤκουσαν τὰ κακά μου, καὶ ἐχάρησαν, ὅτι σὺ ἐποίησας· ἐπήγαγες ἡμέραν, ἐκάλεσας καιρὸν, ἐγένοντο ὅμοιοι ἐμοί.

verses.geez: ታው። ለትባእ፡ ኵሉ፡ እከዮሙ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ ወተቀረሞሙ፡ ዘከመ፡ ተቀረምከ፡ ኪያየ፡ አንተ፡ በኵሉ፡ ኀጢአትየ፡ እስመ፡ በዝኀ፡ ናህክየ፡ ወልብየኒ፡ ያጠውቀኒ።
verses.translation: Thau. Let all their wickedness come before thy face; and strip them, as they have made a gleaning for all my sins: for my groans are many, and my heart is grieved.

translations.lxx: Thau. Let all their wickedness come before thy face; and strip them, as they have made a gleaning for all my sins: for my groans are many, and my heart is grieved.
translations.kjv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
translations.ron: Toată fărădelegea lor să vină înaintea Ta şi să le faci lor precum mi-ai făcut mie, pentru toate păcatele mele! Căci suspinele mele sunt fără de număr, iar inima mea boleşte!
translations.grk: ΘΑΥ. Εἰσέλθοι πᾶσα ἡ κακία αὐτῶν κακὰ πρόσωπόν σου, καὶ ἐπιφύλλισον αὐτοῖς, ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν ἐπιφυλλίδα περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁμαρτημάτων μου, ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ στεναγμοί μου, καὶ ἡ καρδία μου λυπεῖται.

note: How lonely sits the city that was full of people. Jerusalem's destruction lamented. Read alongside 4 Baruch 1 for Jeremiah's perspective, and alongside Kebra Nagast 84 for the Ethiopian interpretation: the Ark had already left before destruction came.
